serie: Casei com o Mendigo e Ele Era Dono do Banco
mundo: Present-day São Paulo, Brazil (2026): an upscale mansion with a garden wedding at golden hour, the leafy public square across the street where a homeless man lives, and the glass headquarters of a private bank. Vertical short drama, Realism style.

laura.name: Laura
laura.description: Proposed: Architect, only daughter of a broke textile magnate, forced into an arranged marriage to pay her father's debts; at the altar she marries the first man who walks through the gate, a homeless man.
facts: Ethnicity/origin: Brazilian (mixed); Skin tone: light olive; Eye colour: brown
Hair colour: dark brown; Hair length: long, past the shoulders; Hair texture: wavy; Hair styling: worn loose with a side part, soft waves swept to one side

Base outfit: ivory bias-cut satin slip wedding dress with thin straps and a straight neckline, a long ivory chiffon scarf draped around the neck and falling over one shoulder, simple ivory heeled sandals, silver teardrop earrings

archetype.looks: simple, clean everyday or work clothes, soft or bright; something in their hands to give.
archetype.read: The bride sold to pay her father's debt who marries a stranger rather than lose herself; the viewer loves her nerve and her kindness. Status: low. Presentation: natural.

teo.name: Téo
teo.description: Proposed: The missing heir of Brazil's biggest private bank, who vanished two years ago after discovering a plot against him and lives in the square across from the Valente mansion, where people call him Barba; cultured, ironic and kind.
facts: Ethnicity/origin: Brazilian (white); Skin tone: fair with a warm undertone; Eye colour: hazel brown
Hair colour: dark brown; Hair length: shoulder-length; Hair texture: thick and wavy; Hair styling: wild and unkempt
Facial hair: very long, full, untrimmed dark brown beard

Base outfit: worn long brown wool overcoat with frayed cuffs and one missing button, a faded grey henley underneath, dark worn trousers, scuffed brown leather boots, black knit fingerless gloves, a vintage gold wristwatch on the left wrist (the one clue to his wealth)

archetype.looks: before the turn plain, worn or work clothes and one detail that hints at the hidden power; after the turn severe, expensive clothes.
archetype.read: The bearded vagrant the wedding guests mock, secretly the missing heir of the country's biggest bank; the viewer waits for the reveal. Status: low_to_high. Presentation: natural.

henrique.name: Henrique
henrique.description: Proposed: The arranged groom, heir of a real-estate developer, arrogant and polished, who poses as the Valente family's saviour while secretly owning their debt.
facts: Ethnicity/origin: Brazilian (white); Skin tone: fair; Eye colour: grey-blue
Hair colour: black; Hair length: short; Hair texture: straight; Hair styling: slicked back with pomade

Base outfit: ivory shawl-collar dinner jacket in fine wool, crisp white pleated-front dress shirt, black silk bow tie, black tuxedo trousers with a satin side stripe, gold cufflinks, polished black patent oxford shoes, a small white rose boutonniere

archetype.looks: a too-perfect look - an innocent white or soft dress in expensive fabric and flawless hair, or a tight, bold outfit and bold makeup; nothing worn or accidental.
archetype.read: The polished groom who poses as the family's saviour while secretly owning their debt; the viewer wants him exposed. Status: high. Presentation: staged.

augusto.name: Augusto
augusto.description: Proposed: Laura's father, owner of a bankrupt textile empire who keeps up appearances and owes R$300 million to the Monteiro bank; he arranged her marriage to save the company.
facts: Ethnicity/origin: Brazilian (white); Skin tone: fair and ruddy; Eye colour: brown
Hair colour: silver grey; Hair length: short; Hair texture: straight; Hair styling: combed back
Base outfit: black three-piece suit in fine wool, crisp white dress shirt, oxblood silk tie with a gold tie bar, oxblood pocket square, a heavy gold wristwatch

archetype.looks: showy wealth or force - designer clothes, logos, gold, heavy jewellery, or the gear of brute strength - and people around them.
archetype.read: The proud, broke patriarch who sells his daughter's hand to save his company; the viewer wants him humbled. Status: high. Presentation: showy.

celeste.name: Dona Celeste
celeste.description: Proposed: Téo's grandmother, the icy chairwoman of the Monteiro bank's board, who searched for her grandson for two years and decides who deserves the family name.
facts: Ethnicity/origin: Brazilian (white); Skin tone: fair; Eye colour: grey-blue
Hair colour: silver white; Hair length: chin-length; Hair texture: straight; Hair styling: sleek bob
Base outfit: tailored charcoal bouclé skirt suit, ivory silk blouse, a double strand of pearls, pearl stud earrings, low black leather heels

archetype.looks: the clothes of their job or place - a uniform, a suit with an earpiece, an elder's formal elegance, the ordinary clothes of a crowd.
archetype.read: The icy matriarch of the bank who reveals who her grandson really is and judges his bride; the viewer fears her verdict. Status: mid. Presentation: functional.

osvaldo.name: Osvaldo
osvaldo.description: Proposed: The Monteiro family's veteran chauffeur, who has searched for the missing heir for two years and recognises him by his gold watch.
facts: Ethnicity/origin: Black Brazilian; Skin tone: dark brown; Eye colour: dark brown
Hair colour: grey; Hair length: very short; Hair texture: coily; Hair styling: close-cropped
Facial hair: short neat grey beard
Base outfit: black chauffeur suit, white dress shirt, black tie, black peaked chauffeur cap, polished black leather shoes

archetype.looks: the clothes of their job or place - a uniform, a suit with an earpiece, an elder's formal elegance, the ordinary clothes of a crowd.
archetype.read: The loyal family chauffeur who recognises the missing heir by his watch and makes the call that changes everything. Status: mid. Presentation: functional.

juiz.name: The justice of the peace
juiz.description: Proposed: The elderly justice of the peace hired for the Valente wedding, who marries Laura to a homeless man and is the first to notice the Monteiro surname.
facts: Ethnicity/origin: Brazilian (white); Skin tone: fair with a rosy undertone; Eye colour: blue
Hair colour: white; Hair length: short; Hair texture: straight; Hair styling: bald on top with a neat white fringe around the sides
Base outfit: beige linen suit, white dress shirt, burgundy bow tie, brown leather shoes

archetype.read: The flustered justice of the peace who marries the bride to a homeless man and spots a famous surname on the register. Status: mid. Presentation: functional.

barbeiro.name: Seu Nenê
barbeiro.description: Proposed: The old neighbourhood barber who shaves off Téo's beard and is the first to see a black bank card in his hand.
facts: Ethnicity/origin: Brazilian (mixed); Skin tone: medium brown; Eye colour: brown
Hair colour: white; Hair length: short; Hair texture: curly; Hair styling: short white curls neatly trimmed
Base outfit: white short-sleeved barber's tunic buttoned at the side, black trousers, black leather shoes

archetype.read: The old barber who shaves the vagrant clean and gasps at the black card he pays with. Status: low. Presentation: functional.
